result.title: InfCoiL: Coordinated Planner-Controller Learning for Closed-Loop Physics-Based Human-Object Interaction
result.summary: Text- and goal-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) provides an intuitive interface for specifying high-level intents in physics-based character animation. Mapping such intents to physically plausible, contact-rich behaviors naturally calls for a generative planner and a physics-based controller, yet existing planner-controller systems either execute plans open-loop or close the loop while keeping the planner fixed, so execution feedback never reshapes what is planned. We present InfCoiL, a closed-loop framework for physics-based HOI from coordinated planner-controller learning. InfCoiL couples a morphology-aware flow-matching planner with a unified multi-morphology controller through a shared morphology interface in an autoregressive plan-and-execute loop, and alternately fine-tunes both components with reinforcement learning from the same physical rollouts. To optimize the flow-matching planner online, we introduce Semantic Flow Policy Optimization (SFPO), which stochasticizes selected denoising transitions with channel-wise semantic covariance over heterogeneous HOI features and assigns group-relative, sequence-level rewards from complete closed-loop executions. On held-out OMOMO sequences, InfCoiL outperforms open-loop hierarchical baselines in goal-reaching task success and physical tracking accuracy. Project page: https://infcoil.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 InfCoiL 闭环框架：将形态感知的 flow-matching 规划器与统一多形态控制器通过共享形态接口耦合，在自回归「规划—执行」循环中用同一物理 rollout 交替 RL 微调两者，并提出 SFPO 以通道级语义协方差随机化去噪转移、用序列级 group-relative 奖励优化规划器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「执行反馈回写规划器」与用完整闭环执行结果做序列级贡献分配的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 计划生成后如何由执行/验证反馈更新状态、以及轨迹级监督分配提供方法线索，跨域可迁移性待核查。
